_comment: Routes Claude Code's per-project auto-memory into agentBrain. Copy to local/memories/claude-redirect-config.json to override.

symlink._help: On first run for a new project, replaces ~/.claude/projects/<encoded>/memory/ with a symlink to <target_root>/<project-slug>/. Originals are moved to a .pre-redirect-backup/ sibling first.

sync_hook._help: Only used when mode=sync_hook. PostToolUse hook detects writes to ~/.claude/projects/*/memory/*.md and replicates to agentBrain with normalized frontmatter (UUID5 added). Originals can be optionally deleted.

instruction_only._help: Mode that does NOT touch files — relies entirely on CLAUDE.md instructing Claude to route memory writes through /save-learning or new-note.sh. Pure-discipline fallback.

normalize._help: Used during migrate AND sync to add UUID5 + agentBrain frontmatter to files that lack it.
